citations.claim: first violating step: |x|>2.4, cart outside track
one step before violation, still inside track but moving negative velocity
initial state already off-center with negative velocity toward boundary

counterfactual.change: Set initial v from -0.4805 to 0.0 (single field change) – removes initial momentum toward wall, controller can then keep cart in bounds for full 264 steps

explanation: Controller fails to arrest cart drift: with initial x≈-0.31 and v≈-0.48 toward negative track end, pole angle small (-0.05 rad) and balanced, controller force stays <1 N (well below 41.4 N limit) insufficient to decelerate. Cart velocity remains negative and grows to ~-1.37 m/s, crossing x=-2.4 at step 264 despite pole remaining upright (margin 0.718 rad). Changing only initial velocity to 0 removes violation, confirming cause is controller gain/tuning inadequate for off-center initial momentum, not force saturation or external pushes.

violation.detail: cart at x=-2.409 outside the +/-2.4 track

vision_note: Across steps 261 to 264 the blue cart drifts steadily leftward toward the end of the track while the pole stays almost upright and does not tip. By step 264 the cart reaches the left limit and violates the track boundary even though the pole remains balanced.
